findings.highlight: I suppose they wanted to prepare early.
findings.evidenceJa: 前が押してんのかな。
findings.explanation: 前が押す means the preceding booking or session is running late, not that the occupants wanted to prepare early.
findings.japanese:
「前が押してんのかな。
それより何でブースの中に寝袋が？」
findings.todokanai: "I suppose they wanted to prepare early. That aside, though, why is there a sleeping bag in the booth?"

findings.highlight: Which means that what we're working on is…
findings.evidenceJa: それだと、俺たちの担当じゃ…
findings.explanation: The director says classical recording would not be their department; the translation turns that disqualification into an unfinished statement about their current work.
findings.japanese:
「え、でもあれどう聴いてもクラシックだろ？
それだと、俺たちの担当じゃ…」
findings.todokanai: "Eh? There is no doubt that it's classical music. Which means that what we're working on is…"

findings.highlight: We're actually working with…
findings.evidenceJa: ですからまず打ち合わせを…
findings.explanation: Setsuna is proposing that they first hold the planning meeting; the translation invents an explanation of whom they are working with.
findings.japanese: 「ええ、ですからまず打ち合わせを…」
findings.todokanai: "Of course. We're actually working with…"

findings.highlight: most amateur performers
findings.evidenceJa: 下手な芸能人より話題になってる
findings.explanation: 下手な芸能人 means many or run-of-the-mill celebrities, not amateur performers; the contrast is Kazusa's extraordinary publicity despite not being a conventional celebrity.
findings.japanese:
「今、下手な芸能人より話題になってるでしょ彼女？
これまで営業がどれだけ声かけても反応しなかったのに、
それが突然向こうから売り込んできたって…」
findings.todokanai: "She's more popular than most amateur performers nowadays, isn't she? To think that she'd suddenly decide to promote herself despite not responding to any of the attempts of our sales department to reach out to her…"

findings.highlight: They'd at least perform better than when I heard you play for the first time.
findings.evidenceJa: 少なくとも初めて聴いたお前の音の方が上だった
findings.explanation: Kazusa says Haruki himself sounded better the first time she heard him. The translation instead makes an imagined amateur better than that first performance.
findings.japanese:
「素人だってもっと上手く弾くぞ。
少なくとも初めて聴いたお前の音の方が上だった」
findings.todokanai: "Even an amateur would be able to play well, you know? They'd at least perform better than when I heard you play for the first time."

findings.highlight: the dismantled Light Music Club
findings.evidenceJa: 体裁すら整っていなかった同好会
findings.explanation: The club had not even acquired a proper organizational form; it had not been dismantled.
findings.japanese:
何より、体裁すら整っていなかった同好会で、
無理やり学園祭のステージにエントリーしたのだって、
全ての元凶は俺で。
findings.todokanai: And above all, I had forced the dismantled Light Music Club onto the stage of the school festival.

findings.highlight: She kept laughing everything off
findings.evidenceJa: 適当なことばっかり言っててさ
findings.explanation: Kazusa says Setsuna kept tossing out glib or irresponsible suggestions, not that she laughed everything off. The error weakens the teasing callback to Setsuna's reckless enthusiasm.
findings.japanese:
「ふふ、そうだったな。
あいつ、あの時も適当なことばっかり言っててさ、
一人だけなんの苦労もしてなかったもんなぁ」
findings.todokanai: "Hehe, you're right. She kept laughing everything off, and was the only one who didn't have to work hard among us."

findings.highlight: I would have never even thought about something so self-serving as that up until three months ago.
findings.evidenceJa: 三か月前までは、そんな都合のいいこと考えてたんだっけ。
findings.explanation: Haruki says that until three months ago he had entertained that convenient hope. The translation explicitly says he never had.
findings.japanese:
三か月前までは、
そんな都合のいいこと考えてたんだっけ。
findings.todokanai: I would have never even thought about something so self-serving as that up until three months ago.

findings.highlight: you've had the guts to ignore all my warnings in the status reports.
findings.evidenceJa: 事前に相談もなしに全部事後報告で、あげくの果てにこっちの忠告まで無視しやがって
findings.explanation: Hamada says Haruki consulted him about nothing, reported everything only after the fact, and even ignored his advice. The translation relocates the advice into nonexistent status reports and loses the after-the-fact reporting charge.
findings.japanese:
「事前に相談もなしに全部事後報告で、
あげくの果てにこっちの忠告まで無視しやがって」
findings.todokanai: "You haven't discussed anything with me and you've had the guts to ignore all my warnings in the status reports."

findings.highlight: So she was right about Mari-san…
findings.evidenceJa: 言ってきたってのは当たりだったんだ…
findings.explanation: Matsuoka realizes Suzuki correctly guessed that Mari had contacted Hamada. The translation supplies no coherent referent and says an unidentified woman was right about Mari.
findings.japanese: 「言ってきたってのは当たりだったんだ…」
findings.todokanai: "So she was right about Mari-san…"

findings.highlight: packages of multi-function printing paper and ink
findings.evidenceJa: まだ梱包されたままの複合機にプリンタ用紙にインク
findings.explanation: The list contains a still-boxed multifunction printer, printer paper, and ink. The translation collapses the machine and paper into the nonexistent product 'multi-function printing paper.'
findings.japanese:
傍らには、山と積まれた家電製品。
まだ梱包されたままの複合機にプリンタ用紙にインク。
それに、デザインソフトのパッケージ。
findings.todokanai: There's a pile of miscellaneous items beside me. They include still-wrapped packages of multi-function printing paper and ink, as well as a graphics software package.

findings.highlight: I barely managed to keep these expenses within the company's allocated budget.
findings.evidenceJa: 会社の経費で落ちるかは思い切り微妙な線
findings.explanation: Haruki doubts whether the company will reimburse the purchases at all; he is not saying they barely fit an allocated budget.
findings.japanese:
…全部でいくらかかったかは思い出したくない。
何しろ会社の経費で落ちるかは思い切り微妙な線だし。
findings.todokanai: …I don't even want to think about how much all that cost. After all, I barely managed to keep these expenses within the company's allocated budget.

findings.highlight: until the concert
findings.evidenceJa: もう本番まで時間ないんだよ
findings.explanation: In this studio sequence 本番 is the imminent recording proper, not Kazusa's separate concert.
findings.japanese:
「…わかったら早くセッティングしろ。
もう本番まで時間ないんだよ」
findings.todokanai: "…If you understand, then hurry and get things set up, already. We don't have much time left until the concert."

findings.highlight: Why wouldn't he help me himself?
findings.evidenceJa: なんで、助けがいるんだよ
findings.explanation: Kazusa asks why help was needed at all, exposing her hurt that Haruki could not keep their secret self-contained. The translation invents a complaint that Haruki personally refused to help her.
findings.japanese:
「どうして他の女に助けを求めるんだよ。
…なんで、助けがいるんだよ」
findings.todokanai: "Why would he ask another woman for help? …Why wouldn't he help me himself?"

findings.highlight: That's because there's no need for words in this case.
findings.evidenceJa: ピンと来なかったってことだよね
findings.explanation: Setsuna interprets their silence as proof the design failed to click with them. The translation romanticizes the silence as communication beyond words, reversing the evaluative point.
findings.japanese:
「うん、かずさも春希くんも一言もなかった。
…ピンと来なかったってことだよね」
findings.todokanai: "Yeah, neither you or Kazusa actually said anything, Haruki-kun. …That's because there's no need for words in this case."

findings.highlight: I'm sure he has a backup plan prepared in advance, and will definitely have some solution ready
findings.evidenceJa: 実はもう手を回してくれていて、明日会社に行ったら何もかも解決してたりとか…
findings.explanation: Haruki is desperately entertaining a possibility: perhaps Hamada has arranged something and everything might be solved tomorrow. 'I'm sure' and 'definitely' erase the uncertainty that drives his temptation to compromise.
findings.japanese:
浜田さんはああやって大げさに言ったけど、
実はもう手を回してくれていて、
明日会社に行ったら何もかも解決してたりとか…
findings.todokanai: As harsh as Hamada-san was earlier, I'm sure he has a backup plan prepared in advance, and will definitely have some solution ready when I arrive at the company tomorrow…

findings.highlight: Let's not make it too flashy… no, let's actually just not go for that at all…
findings.evidenceJa: あんまり色使わなくてさ…いや、全然使わなくてさ…
findings.explanation: Kazusa specifically proposes using few colors, then no color at all. The translation replaces the concrete path to a white jacket with generic flashiness and an unclear rejection.
findings.japanese:
「あんまり色使わなくてさ…
いや、全然使わなくてさ…」
findings.todokanai: "Let's not make it too flashy… no, let's actually just not go for that at all…"

findings.highlight: Three heads are better than one, after all, so I see nothing but positives from us pooling our wisdom together.
findings.evidenceJa: 三人寄れば知恵も出るし矢も折れないし姦しいし
findings.explanation: Setsuna comically piles together three separate three-person sayings: three heads produce wisdom, three arrows do not break, and three women are noisy. Todokanai TL keeps only the first, deleting both the escalating joke and Haruki's response to 'the last one.'
findings.japanese:
「そうだよね。
三人寄れば知恵も出るし矢も折れないし姦しいし
いいこと尽くめだよ」
findings.todokanai: "That's right. Three heads are better than one, after all, so I see nothing but positives from us pooling our wisdom together."

findings.highlight: This is quite the tight schedule…
findings.evidenceJa: なんというタイトロープスケジュール…
findings.explanation: The coined 'tightrope schedule' continues the chapter's repeated tightrope imagery. Reducing it to a merely tight schedule deletes the callback.
findings.japanese: なんというタイトロープスケジュール…
findings.todokanai: This is quite the tight schedule…

findings.highlight: I'd probably end up getting chased away by her in a rage.
findings.evidenceJa: わたしがあの子なら怒鳴り散らすわね
findings.explanation: Youko says that if she were Kazusa, she herself would yell at an interrupter. The translation instead has Kazusa angrily chase Youko away.
findings.japanese:
「わたしがあの子なら怒鳴り散らすわね。
『今いいところなんだから邪魔するな』って…」
findings.todokanai: "I'd probably end up getting chased away by her in a rage. She'd probably say something like, 'don't bother me at a time like this'…"

findings.highlight: I suppose I wouldn't want to break the deadline I've established.
findings.evidenceJa: まぁ、とっくにデッドライン破ってるからなぁ
findings.explanation: Kazusa says their deadline has already been blown. Todokanai TL changes this into her desire not to break a deadline she established.
findings.japanese:
「まぁ、とっくにデッドライン破ってるからなぁ。
今さら頑張ったところで間に合うのやら…」
findings.todokanai: "Well, I suppose I wouldn't want to break the deadline I've established. I'm not sure if he'll make it in time even if he works hard at this point…"

findings.highlight: Todokanai Koi
findings.evidenceJa: 『届かない恋』の時も
findings.explanation: The load-bearing song title is left as untranslated romaji rather than translated as Love Beyond Reach, breaking English-edition title continuity.
findings.japanese:
「『届かない恋』の時も、
そうだったこと、知ってるもん」
findings.todokanai: "I knew this even when we worked on Todokanai Koi back then."

findings.highlight: I sought to become two amongst the three of us… I wanted to become two with him.
findings.evidenceJa: 三人でいることを二人に求めておきながら、自分は彼と二人になることを求めた。
findings.explanation: Setsuna confesses the contradiction plainly: while asking the other two to preserve the trio, she herself sought to be alone with Haruki. The first translated sentence is nonsensical and duplicates the second instead of stating what she demanded of Haruki and Kazusa.
findings.japanese:
「三人でいることを二人に求めておきながら、
自分は彼と二人になることを求めた。
…かずさのこと、出し抜いた」
findings.todokanai: "I sought to become two amongst the three of us… I wanted to become two with him. …And I ended up stealing the march on you, Kazusa."

findings.highlight: the lyrics I poured my heart and soul into for a day and a half
findings.evidenceJa: 一日と半日遅れた北原春希入魂…かもしれない新曲の詞
findings.explanation: 一日と半日遅れた means the lyrics are a day and a half late. Todokanai TL instead treats that duration as the time Haruki spent pouring himself into them.
findings.japanese:
一日と半日遅れた北原春希入魂…
かもしれない新曲の詞を書き連ねたノートを抱え、
スタジオの中に飛び込んだ瞬間…
findings.todokanai: The moment I bolted into the studio while carrying a notebook filled with the lyrics I poured my heart and soul into for a day and a half…

findings.highlight: despite my mentions of "although" and "however."
findings.evidenceJa: 俺の『けど』や『ですが』以前までの台詞に満面の笑みを見せた
findings.explanation: Hamada smiles at only the portion of Haruki's report before each 'but' or 'however,' deliberately ignoring the caveats. Todokanai TL says he smiles despite hearing them.
findings.japanese:
最近、俺のせいで色々と胃を痛めていただろう浜田さんは、
俺の『けど』や『ですが』以前までの台詞に
満面の笑みを見せた。
findings.todokanai: Hamada-san, who I imagine was put under a lot of stress because of me, responds to my explanation with a wide smile on his face despite my mentions of "although" and "however."

findings.highlight: I have to work on site for the entire month.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺、今月そんな現場ばっかり
findings.explanation: The staffer complains that all his recording jobs this month have been troubled like this one, not that he has been assigned to one site for the whole month.
findings.japanese:
「嘘ぉ、勘弁してよ…
俺、今月そんな現場ばっかり」
findings.todokanai: "You're kidding, spare me already… I have to work on site for the entire month."

findings.highlight: what, did Ogata Eiji suddenly decide to get involved in this?
findings.evidenceJa: どこの緒方英二だよ
findings.explanation: The director jokes 'Who do they think they are, Eiji Ogata?' about composing during the recording session, a White Album callback. The translation invents Ogata personally becoming involved in their project.
findings.japanese:
「収録中にスタジオの中で作曲とか…
どこの緒方英二だよ」
findings.todokanai: "Having to make a song in the studio in the middle of a recording session… what, did Ogata Eiji suddenly decide to get involved in this?"

findings.highlight: I've taken out countless days off this month
findings.evidenceJa: 私たちは今月いっぱい予定取ってあるからいいけど
findings.explanation: The staff are booked or have held their schedules open through the end of the month. The woman has not taken countless vacation days.
findings.japanese:
「そりゃ、私たちは
今月いっぱい予定取ってあるからいいけど…」
findings.todokanai: "Well, I've taken out countless days off this month, so that's actually fine, but…"

findings.highlight: Let's change the tempo here…
findings.evidenceJa: ここで転調入れるか…
findings.explanation: 転調 is a modulation or key change, not a tempo change.
findings.japanese:
「ん～んん～…と。
ここで転調入れるか…」
findings.todokanai: "Hmm～ mmm～… Alright. Let's change the tempo here…"

findings.highlight: Entry hours begin at 3 PM
findings.evidenceJa: １５時に会場入りだから
findings.explanation: Kazusa is due to arrive at the venue at 3 p.m.; this is not a statement that public entry hours begin then.
findings.japanese:
「１５時に会場入りだから…
それまでには曲を仕上げてもらう。
できるよね、かずさ？」
findings.todokanai: "Entry hours begin at 3 PM… so we should try to have the song finished before that time. You can do that, right, Kazusa?"
